title: Sum of Integers with Maximum Digit Range
summary: Given an integer array, calculate the digit range for each number as the difference between its largest and smallest digits.
statement: Given an integer array, calculate the digit range for each number as the difference between its largest and smallest digits. Sum all numbers whose digit range matches the maximum digit range found in the array.
constraints: The digit range of a positive integer is its largest digit minus its smallest digit.
Find the maximum digit range among nums.
Return the sum of every number tied for that maximum.
hints: Compute each number’s minimum and maximum decimal digit.
Store their difference beside the number.
Sum all original numbers whose stored difference equals it.
editorial: Sum all original numbers whose stored difference equals it.

tests.explanation: The ranges are five, zero, and five, so 5724 and 350 sum to 6074.
Every single-valued digit set has range zero, so all three numbers are summed.
